name: design_primers
description: Design PCR primers for a template DNA sequence using Primer3 with Tm and product size constraints
usage: from app.tools.biomni.molecular_biology import design_primers; result = design_primers('ATGGCTAGCTAGCGATCGATCG...', product_size_range=(100, 500), tm_range=(55, 65), output_dir='output/')

parameters.template_sequence: str — DNA template sequence to design primers for
parameters.product_size_range: tuple — (min, max) PCR product size in bp (default (100, 500))

returns: dict with keys: template_length, primer_pairs (list of {pair_id, left_sequence, right_sequence, product_size, tm_left, tm_right, penalty})
